acceptance_criteria: A merchant who acknowledged at 14:59 can have that SAME quote accepted by Operations 30 minutes later, with no Quote N+1 and the same subtotal.

Customer authorization at 14:59 applies; at exactly 15:00 it is refused.
An obligation authorized in time is still authorized at 45 minutes.
A payment token with days of TTL remaining cannot open an expired quote.
A late webhook for an approval obtained inside the window still applies; the same webhook for an out-of-window approval is still refused.
The reconcile path never dates an authorization from PaymentIntent.created.
The rollback removes both predicates, the reuse helper, and the 9-argument apply, leaving exactly one 8-argument form.

It expired quotes a payer had already approved, and left the real customer approval boundary — couranr_apply_payment_intent_state — unguarded, so an obligation created while the quote was fresh made the price immortal. Approval is now DERIVED from the evidence that already exists rather than duplicated into a flag.

decisions.decision: Consumer Smart Intake on /send is INT-001 applied unchanged to the anonymous guest, who is the TRUSTED ACTOR for their OWN request only. AI proposes a count, fragility, and a weight or restricted-class suggestion from the guest's description — closed-vocabulary, numeric or boolean facts only, because no free-text model output is ever rendered to a guest; Couranr's deterministic policy and Pricing V2 remain the only authorities; the guest confirms every material fact by an explicit form action (choosing a suggestion or stating the value themselves) and nothing is prefilled silently; the server commits. The guest is told at the START of the item step that AI reads the description. The anonymous surface carries its own abuse controls: one paid call per description revision (identical trimmed words never buy another), 12 paid calls per guest session per rolling hour, ONE global consumer allowance of 300 paid calls per rolling hour, a kill switch (COURANR_CONSUMER_INTAKE must equal 'live'; absent means unavailable with zero provider calls and zero writes), and a 4000-character input cap. The provider payload is the same minimized shape as INT-001 (description, no business category, confirmed non-PII facts) with phone, email and card patterns redacted; recipient contact and addresses never travel. Human review stays exactly where §13 puts it; a model conclusion still cannot move price, state, route or a restricted outcome.
